subtests.name: Setting dir=rtl on an ancestor does not change the directionality of a bdi with LTR content
Changing an ancestor from dir=ltr to dir=rtl does not change the directionality of a bdi with LTR content
Removing and re-adding dir=rtl on an ancestor does not change the directionality of a bdi with LTR content
Changing an ancestor from dir=auto to dir=rtl does not change the directionality of a bdi with LTR content
